themes.label: Selloff accelerates; escalation lines within reach
themes.narrative: The post-earnings relief failed and the market is now pricing a broad de-rating, not a semis-only correction: QQQ is down 3.58% today and 11.71% over the month.
themes.dataAnchor: Through Thursday's close: SPX 7,175.83, 8.52% below its 120-day high, 6.08% below its 50-day and 2.34% below its 200-day ($7,348.02); 5-day return -5.49%. Intraday Friday at 12:06 ET: VIX 31.6 (+11.11%, after a 28.44 close), SPY $702.39 (-1.88%), which scales SPX to roughly 7,041 — about 10% below its high and about 41 points above the 7,000 escalation trigger. NVDA trades at $135.93 against its $130 trigger.
themes.counterRead: Every escalation trigger is close-based and none has tripped yet. But VIX is already above 30 and the volume-climax signal reads 0.87x average with Thursday's close at the bottom 1% of its range — selling, not capitulation. A close below 7,000 or NVDA below $130 today moves the ladder down a rung going into the weekend.
themes.watchFor: Today's close: SPX vs 7,000, NVDA vs $130, VIX vs 35.

themes.label: Leveraged and thematic holdings take the full drawdown
themes.narrative: The leveraged and thematic book is being sold hardest — the market is unwinding risk where it is most concentrated.
themes.dataAnchor: Today: TQQQ -10.88% (-34.24% over the month), TSLT -11.05%, VRT -10.89%, SMR -10.5%, BMNR -8.03% (-38.4% over the month), DOGE -7.65%, ETH-USD -6.99%, VST -5.64%, CONL -6.42% (-63.43% over the month). BTC-USD is -4.34% today and -23.29% over the month.
themes.counterRead: TQQQ, TSLT, CONL, BMNR, VRT, VST and DOGE are all holdings, so this is where the portfolio's loss is concentrated. The plan is explicit: nothing sells into the break, and nothing is added while the stand-down is in force. The NVDX $12 calls (Dec 18) are effectively worthless with NVDX at $6.89 and a $0 bid — they are a sunk cost, not a decision.
themes.watchFor: BTC: a fresh -5% day confirms the crypto leg is still unwinding; TQQQ two closes without a new low is the first stabilization sign.

themes.label: AI complex: fundamentals ahead of price, but below the floors
themes.narrative: The market has abandoned the AI build-out trade after the NVDA print: NVDA is down 34.2% over the month and 44.1% below its 52-week high.
themes.dataAnchor: At Thursday's close NVDA was $145.98, 40.02% below its 120-day high with RSI 19.6; SMH $447.48 was 33.39% below its high and 14.78% below its 200-day, both below Zone 2. Fundamentals still lead: NVDA conviction score 83 (revenue +61.4% YoY); AVGO +55% YoY at 30% below its high; DDOG +27.7% YoY, 44.6% below (score 84, tier A); ONTO +41.5% YoY, 49.3% below; LRCX +131.3% YoY, 53.6% below.
themes.counterRead: Data ahead of price is the setup, but below the Zone 2 floors the setup is broken, not cheaper. NVDA would need to rally about 29% from today's $135.93 to reach its $175 floor. These names stay on watch until a reclaim plus a tally of 3 of 4.
themes.watchFor: NVDA close vs $130 (escalation) and $175 (re-arm); SMH close vs $430 (escalation).

themes.label: Credit still has not confirmed the equity panic
themes.narrative: Equity volatility is pricing stress while credit says it is still a correction: VIX is up 66.05% over the month.
themes.dataAnchor: HY OAS is 3.52, up from 3.34 on Tuesday but still well below the 4% crack line; lending standards LOOSE (SLOOS 1.7%); 2s10s +0.27; 10Y 5.07%. Mag7 averages 22.99% below 52-week highs vs SPY 10.1%, a 12.89-point gap.
themes.counterRead: Credit calm is the one tally signal still confirmed, and it is the reason this reads as a correction, not a regime break. HY OAS has widened 0.18 since Tuesday; above 4% the 'correction, not regime break' read is void and the stand-down extends.
themes.watchFor: HY OAS close above 4% (stand-down extends, Tranche triggers void).

themes.label: Gold is not hedging the selloff
themes.narrative: The usual hedges are not working: gold is falling with equities instead of offsetting them.
themes.dataAnchor: IAU is -3.2% today and -12.08% over the month; the dollar index is +2.1% over the month; real 10Y 2.91% with the 10Y at 5.07%.
themes.counterRead: IAU is a holding (90 shares) bought as ballast, and it is adding to the drawdown, not cushioning it. Cash ($3,153.65) is the only position not losing value; the plan's 'hold bills' line is doing the work the hedge was meant to.
themes.watchFor: IAU two closes without a new low while equities fall — the first sign the hedge is working again.

strategyPosture: Watch — stand-down in force and deepening: VIX is 31.6 intraday, SPX is about 41 points above the 7,000 escalation trigger, and SMH and NVDA are below their Zone 2 floors with the tally at 1 of 4. No new deployment, no averaging down, and nothing sells into the break; hold existing positions and cash.
whereWaveBuilds: Today's close decides whether the selloff escalates into the weekend: SPX below 7,000 or NVDA below $130 moves the ladder down a rung, while HY OAS holding under 4% keeps it a correction. A relief bounce from here is the trap case until it survives a retest.
watchFor: SPX close vs 7,000; NVDA close vs $130; SMH close vs $430 (escalation).
VIX close above 35 or HY OAS above 4% (stand-down extends, Tranche triggers void).
Volume climax: SMH volume above 1.5x average with an intraday reversal — the missing capitulation signal.
PCE (Oct) Nov 25 and the Dec 8-9 FOMC with the 10Y at 5.07%.

reaction.episode: CORRECTION episode through the Nov 19 close: SPX 7,175.83, 8.52% below its 120-day high and 2.34% below its 200-day; SMH $447.48 and NVDA $145.98 both below Zone 2; VIX 28.44 at its 5-day high; HY OAS 3.52; tally 1 of 4. Intraday Nov 20 at 12:06 ET: VIX 31.6, SPY -1.88% (SPX about 7,041), NVDA $135.93.

ladder.trigger: SPX closes below 7,000, or SMH below $430, or NVDA below $130
ladder.response: No buying; the staged-selling plan arms Stage 1 only on a strength day — nothing sells into the break; hold cash.

ladder.trigger: A bounce carries SPX into the 7,750-7,820 failure zone (SMH $580-600) and fails there
ladder.response: Treat it as a bull trap: no chasing the first bounce; entries wait for the failure-zone retest verdict, and any probe is sized as a probe, not a tranche.

ladder.trigger: HY OAS closes above 4%, or VIX closes above 35
ladder.response: Stand-down extends and Tranche A/B triggers are void until HY OAS is back below 4% and VIX closes below 25.

ladder.trigger: SMH and NVDA both close back inside Zone 2 (SMH $470-505, NVDA $175-185) with the mechanical tally at 3 of 4 or better
ladder.response: Tranche A re-arms (25% deployment per the ladder); below the floors, the setup is broken, not cheaper.

reaction.invalidation: A daily SPX close back above its 50-day (about 7,640) with SMH and NVDA reclaimed into Zone 2 and VIX below 25 voids the Watch stance; HY OAS above 4% with SPX below 7,000 voids the 'correction, not regime break' read and the ladder with it.
reaction.trapRisk: After a 5.49% five-day drop with VIX above 30, a sharp Friday-afternoon or Monday bounce is likely and is the trap case: no chasing it. Entries wait for a volume-climax reversal or a failed retest that holds, and for VIX to close back below 25.
